page_title: NEW 3-1 WHU | Newcastle v West Ham 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort.
90+2' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jarred Gillett who sees an offensive foul.
90+1' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nick Pope, who smothers the ball.
89' The resulting corner, taken by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd), comes to nothing.
88' Wow, what an escape. Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
87' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
85' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) replaces William Osula.
85' Kieran Trippier comes off the pitch to be replaced by Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd).
83' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jarred Gillett ignores the protests.
80' It's like he was asking for a caution. Mohamadou Kante (West Ham) receives a yellow card.
78' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) smashes the ball against the crossbar! What a chance. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
77' Callum Wilson (West Ham) makes a good run inside the box to meet a precise cross. He latches on to it and shoots, but the goalkeeper pulls off an excellent save.
75' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Nick Woltemade will be replaced by Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd).
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Harvey Barnes as he is replaced by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd).

75' Nick Pope makes a brilliant save! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by keeper!
74' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
73' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but Nick Pope comes off his line to gather the ball.
72' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

72' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Mads Hermansen pulls off a comfortable save.

69' 3 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Taty Castellanos (West Ham) produces a brilliant first-time effort from the edge of the penalty area after receiving the ball from Mads Hermansen. The goalkeeper somehow couldn't stop the shot from reaching the roof of the net.
68' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
67' A yellow card for a tackle by El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham). Jarred Gillett doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
65' 3 - 0 Joe Willock provides William Osula (Newcastle Utd) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
63' Today's match ends for Tomas Soucek who will be replaced by Mohamadou Kante (West Ham).
63' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Aaron Wan-Bissaka and he is replaced by Pablo (West Ham).

63' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. West Ham are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

63' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
59' The referee is firm and issues Tomas Soucek (West Ham) a deserved yellow card.
58' Callum Wilson (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
58' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
57' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Nick Pope.
56' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) is caught offside!
54' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
53' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) comes onto the pitch after Sandro Tonali signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
51' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
50' The attendance is 52206.
47' A pass by Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged offside.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

44' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Mads Hermansen, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
42' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
39' The corner from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by the defence.
39' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The referee signals a corner kick to Newcastle.
38' Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Newcastle.
36' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
34' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
32' Callum Wilson (West Ham) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
29' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
27' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle and it's Taty Castellanos (West Ham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
26' Here comes a substitution. Taty Castellanos (West Ham) is brought on as a substitute for Jean-Clair Todibo.
25' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
24' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) takes a short corner kick.
23' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
22' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
21' The ball is cleared after Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.

19' 2 - 0 Goal! Jacob Ramsey puts William Osula (Newcastle Utd) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully low into the middle of the goal. 2:0.
17' Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

15' 1 - 0 Harvey Barnes sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
14' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
13' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
12' The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
12' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
12' William Osula (Newcastle Utd) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
11' Axel Disasi (West Ham) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
10' Newcastle take a short corner kick.
9' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner.
7' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
4' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
2' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' The first half has just begun.
